name: Water Sprite
description: A sprite is a creature purely composed of a single element created by primordial magic. While non-sentient, they can utilize basic elemental magic according to their type. These types of creatures are often difficult to distinguish from naturally occuring elements.

actions.name: Splash
actions.description: The Water Sprite splashes magical water at a target, dealing cold damage.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Water
traits.description: While submerged in water, the Water Sprite gains an additional 4 units of movement to it's hover speed.
